stdout:
#!/bin/sh
set -e

ORIGIN_IMG=/srv/snapstore/origin.img
COW_IMG=/srv/snapstore/cow.img

# Reattach loop devices deterministically (idempotent).
find_or_attach() {
    img="$1"
    existing=$(losetup -j "$img" | cut -d: -f1)
    if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
        echo "$existing"
    else
        losetup -f "$img" --show
    fi
}

LOOP_ORIGIN=$(find_or_attach "$ORIGIN_IMG")
LOOP_COW=$(find_or_attach "$COW_IMG")

SECTORS=1048576

if ! dmsetup info data-origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    dmsetup create data-origin --table "0 $SECTORS snapshot-origin $LOOP_ORIGIN"
fi
